full_finetuning_bf16.minimum_hardware_recommendation: 4x NVIDIA A100 80GB (320GB aggregate VRAM) with DeepSpeed ZeRO-3

lora_bf16_rank16.minimum_hardware_recommendation: 1x NVIDIA A100 80GB or 2x RTX 4090 24GB with ZeRO-2

deepspeed_zero3_cpu_offload.minimum_hardware_recommendation: Workstation with 128GB DDR5 RAM, PCIe 4.0 NVMe, and 16GB GPU

local_environment_evaluation.verdict: 27B direct local training is mathematically infeasible on a 4 GB VRAM GPU even in INT4 quantization (14.85 GB base weights alone exceed 4 GB VRAM by 3.7x).
local_environment_evaluation.autonomous_strategy:
1. Provide full production multi-GPU DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 / FSDP / QLoRA distributed training pipeline for 27B deployment.
2. Provide local runnable pipeline on CodeForge-H hybrid architecture (126.9M) to validate data ingestion, tokenization, assistant-only masking, LoRA training, and evaluation without OOM.
3. Integrate with pre-installed quantized 27B model on Ollama (http://127.0.0.1:11434) for local 27B inference and agent verification.
